verdict.rationale: Fivetran offers a REST API to set up and manage pipelines programmatically, a Connector SDK for custom connectors, and dedicated AI coding-agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) that let an agent build, test, and deploy connectors via natural language, plus an MCP server for read/write/delete pipeline operations headlessly. This covers scaffold+configure+run largely agent-drivable, but evidence is fragmented across separate tools (SDK vs REST API vs MCP) rather than one unified headless workflow, and no OpenAPI spec was found (404s on probe). Missing for 10: a single end-to-end example combining connector creation, transformation orchestration, and destination setup fully through CLI/API in one flow, and independent hands-on confirmation of agent-driven pipeline runs.
